units.source_text: 然而，到了真要拍摄的时候，我又感到拍这张照片责任重大，没有信心。

en.t: However, when the time actually came to take the photograph, I again felt the heavy responsibility of taking it and had no confidence.

units.source_text: 再说我的照相机快门常常失灵，可能拍不成功。

en.t: Besides, the shutter on my camera often failed, so I might not be able to take the picture properly.

units.source_text: 幸亏当时有位摄影师从东京来这里拍摄红叶节的情况，也住在抚松庵，我便拜托他，请他给拍张名人遗容的照片。

en.t: Fortunately, at the time there was a photographer who had come from Tokyo to photograph the maple festival and was also staying at Fushou-an, so I asked him to take a posthumous photograph of the master.

units.source_text: 我贸然地把同名人毫无交情的摄影师带去，名人的遗孀也许不愿意，但他肯定比我拍得好。

en.t: If I rashly brought along a photographer who had no connection with the master, his widow might not like it, but he would certainly take a better picture than I could.

units.source_text: 红叶节的主办人却露出为难的神色说：让专程前来拍摄红叶节的摄影师去干别的事可不好办。

en.t: But the organizer of the maple festival looked troubled and said that it would be difficult to have a photographer who had come especially to photograph the festival go off to do something else.

units.source_text: 从今早起，只有我一个人为名人的死感到悲恸。

en.t: Since this morning, I alone had been grieving over the master's death.

units.source_text: 我的心情同参加红叶节的人很不协调。

en.t: My state of mind was badly out of step with the people attending the maple festival.

units.source_text: 我请摄影师帮忙检查照相机快门的故障。

en.t: I asked the photographer to help examine the trouble with my camera shutter.

units.source_text: 摄影师指点我：打开快门，用手掌遮挡替代快门就成。

en.t: The photographer advised me to open the shutter and use my palm to cover the lens in place of the shutter.
He loaded a new roll of film for me.
I drove off in haste to the Uroko-ya inn.
